title: Explicit construction of supported class and trace across a projective-line isomorphism
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, f:X -> S proper, and i:X ≅ P=ProjectiveLine(S) with i followed by the structure map equal to f. Use ordinary finite derived inverse/direct images and normalized twists [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows], supported Ext realization [lem-sp-finite-p1-diagonal-kummer-component-formula], compact-support diagonal maps [lem-sf-diagonal-kernel-integral-triangles], and proper exchange [lem-kun-proper-base-change-torsion-ring]. Construct q=i times_S i by pullback.map and prove its projection and diagonal squares Cartesian. Define the constant-unit comparison using the monoidal unit of the constant-sheaf functor and the degree-zero single functor. Define diagonalLift from RDelta_X! A_X to Lq* RDelta_P* A_P using proper forget-supports, the inverse constant comparison and inverse diagonal exchange. Define projectionComparison as proper forget-supports followed by inverse projection exchange. For N A=0, normalized twist transport t, and N invertible on S, define coefficientComparison by the two normalized shifted-line pullbacks. Pull an arbitrary supported Ext class across q, precompose by diagonalLift and postcompose by coefficientComparison, obtaining diagonalClass. Use the splitting target of [lem-sp-finite-p1-kummer-naturality] and transport invertibility by [lem-sp-finite-p1-unit-on-pullback]. Define trace for any specified ordinary P1 trace tau by proper forget-supports, inverse line pullback, direct-image composition for i;r=f, cancellation of Ri* Li* along i, and tau followed by the constant-unit comparison. Define middleComparison by inverse coefficient comparison followed by projectionComparison. Finally diagonalUnit is the existing compact-support section map for either projection and coordinateTrace is inverse proper exchange followed by pullback of the constructed trace, with the existing coordinate correction in the second case. No map is chosen from an existence statement and no integral identity is imposed. Package the two constructed arrows as datum, with proved equations for its class and trace fields. The Ext realization is named supportedMap with fixed ordinary direct-image and shifted-line endpoints, so diagram proofs use its typed API. The intermediate comparison is packaged by the generic irreducible middleComposite, so its concrete coefficient isomorphism is not expanded by consumers.

source.place: The maps preceding the two coordinate integral computations: the supported diagonal morphism, the two section identifications, and inverse projection exchanges.

proof.text: Construct presentationTrace for an arbitrary complex from inverse direct-image composition and pushPull cancellation. Associativity proves presentationTrace_assoc, which expands the named factor followed by any arrow to the original two factors followed by that arrow. Define trace by the same proper forget-supports and inverse line comparison as before, followed by this named ordinary comparison, the trace arrow, and the constant-unit comparison. Thus the construction is exactly the original one up to associativity. The generic traceComposite constructs the ordered five-factor trace from abstract categorical data, so its specialization retains the original formula while avoiding normalization of concrete coefficient objects.

proof_origin.place: Same explicit construction with its last two ordinary direct-image factors packaged at an arbitrary complex; presentationTrace_assoc proves equality with the former order of factors.
